runner_source:
import subprocess,json,os,shutil,re,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/private/tmp/pamin-coreml-compiled-cache/bge64');root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
model='/private/tmp/pamin-perf58/models/typed-reranker-v3/9b26f9185d2d26051f724c9fc3565e5d9614a9dd459b784c806c246232a70fe3/model.onnx'
exe='/private/tmp/pamin-coreml-compile-cache-bge-frozen'
orders=[['before','after'],['after','before'],['before','after']]
rows=[]
cases=[('prime',0)]+[(arm,i+1) for i,order in enumerate(orders) for arm in order]
for arm,round_index in cases:
 assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free>=10*1024**3+2500000000,'disk preflight: reserve plus temporary model copy'
 name=f'{round_index}-{arm}'
 env=os.environ.copy();env.update(DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH='/private/tmp/pamin-gpu-research/runtime',PROBE_MODEL=model,PROBE_CACHE='disabled' if arm=='before' else str(root/'cache'),PROBE_TOKENS='64',PROBE_SCALE='2',PROBE_PROFILE=str(root/name),PROBE_BGE='1',PROBE_ORACLE=str(root/'logits-bits.json'))
 with open(root/(name+'.stdout'),'w') as stdout,open(root/(name+'.stderr'),'w') as stderr:
  start=time.monotonic();proc=subprocess.Popen([exe,'--exact','compile_cache_probe','--ignored','--nocapture'],env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
  peak=0;failure=None
  while proc.poll() is None:
   status=subprocess.run(['ps','-o','rss=','-p',str(proc.pid)],capture_output=True,text=True)
   if status.returncode==0 and status.stdout.strip():peak=max(peak,int(status.stdout.strip())*1024)
   if peak>8*1024**3:failure='RSS guard'
   if shutil.disk_usage(root).free<10*1024**3:failure='disk guard'
   if failure:proc.terminate();proc.wait();break
   time.sleep(0.25)
  row={'round':round_index,'arm':arm,'exit_code':proc.returncode,'sampled_peak_rss_bytes':peak,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'guard_failure':failure}
  output=(root/(name+'.stdout')).read_text();match=re.search(r'load_seconds=([0-9.]+) forward_seconds=([0-9.]+) max_error=([0-9.]+)',output)
  if match:row.update(load_seconds=float(match[1]),forward_seconds=float(match[2]),max_error=float(match[3]))
  row['retained_cache_logical_bytes']=sum(f.stat().st_size for f in (root/'cache').rglob('*') if f.is_file())
  rows.append(row);(root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
  assert row['exit_code']==0 and not failure,(row,(root/(name+'.stderr')).read_text())
assert len(rows)==7
